fact: The MoCTI Directorate of Technology, with a Software Development and Application Services Unit and a Data Science Unit, is stated to be mandated to support MDAs in planning, deploying and maintaining software, to build and maintain government-wide data infrastructure, and to direct delivery of e-Cabinet, e-Parliament and citizen portals; the page gives no date for the stated thing, so the published date is used.
The Ministry of Finance's DFMST, established in 2022, lists providing technical support to mission critical systems such as IFMIS and CSDRMS among its core functions.

Tech Africa News reports that under the Website Standardisation Framework the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation builds and hosts official websites for ministries, departments and agencies on shared gov.sl infrastructure.
Tech Africa News reports that ICT officers within individual ministries, departments and agencies will manage and update their own websites on the gov.sl platform.
